info.name: Knowledge Collection Service List Knowledge Collections API

params.name: team_id
params.description: Unique identifiers of the teams authorized to the knowledge collection.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Requested page size; default and maximum value are both 100.

params.name: page_token
params.description: Returned for multiple pages; must be specified in each request for two pages per sheet using the page token parameter.

params.name: solution_id
params.description: Licensed solution for the collection; if not provided, the organizational default solution is automatically assigned.

items.docs: List all knowledge collections configured for an organization.
